```{r DNA to RNA}
dna_to_rna <- function(dna_seq){
  #rna_seq <- chartr("T","U",toupper(dna_seq))
  toupper(dna_seq) |> (\(x) chartr("T","U", x))()
}
```

```{r}
dna <- "ATGCCCTGA"
rna <- dna_to_rna(dna)
```

```{r split codons}
split_codon <- function(seq){
  seq <- gsub("[^ATGC]", "", toupper(seq))
  codons <- substring(seq,seq(1,nchar(seq)-2,3),seq(3,nchar(seq),3))
  codons[nchar(codons)==3]
}
```

```{r}
frame_2 <- function(seq){
  n <- nchar(seq)
  codons <- substring(seq,seq(2,n,3),seq(4,n,3))
  codons[nchar(codons)==3]
}
```
